scenario.prompt: Add an offline mode to an existing CLI. I know users should be able to keep working without network access, but I have not decided cache lifetime, conflict behavior, or which commands must work offline.
context: The repository is available to the agent.
A CONTEXT.md already defines Workspace, Snapshot, and Sync Attempt.
Existing code reveals which commands currently call the network.

required_behaviors: Inspect repository facts instead of asking the user which commands currently use the network.
Ask the user only material product/design decisions such as cache lifetime and conflict semantics.
Preserve canonical terms from CONTEXT.md and update the glossary only when a new domain term is actually resolved.
Do not produce the final spec until material decision frontier items are settled or explicitly marked unresolved.
The spec records scope, behavior, implementation decisions, testing decisions, and out-of-scope items.
forbidden_behaviors: Ask the user for facts directly inspectable in the repository.
Invent cache or conflict semantics to finish the spec.
Start implementing production code before the requested planning workflow is complete.
Use a new synonym for an existing canonical domain term without resolving the vocabulary conflict.
completion_criteria: No material decision is silently assumed.
The resulting spec can be handed to to-tickets without reopening basic product decisions.
